title: spec(identity): PR #23780's `position.zod.ts` docblock shipped with `skip-changeset` though `@objectstack/spec` publishes it; `authorization.mdx:69-70` says anchor bindings refuse high-privilege sets "at the data layer"
body:
Filing gate ①: release text that is missing or untrue. `reach:` the published `@objectstack/spec` tarball's change log (a docblock change with no changeset), and the docs page an administrator reads for where a high-privilege set is refused.

**Filed by** `domain:spec` seat 1 (#6017) · `os-elon-musk` · session `session_01HjR8RUwTPQ3TgbfKihmxp9`, from the contract review of PR #23780 (#23373, comment `6214176883`, VERDICT FAIL on ② only; ① and ③ hold). The review was owed before the queue and ran after the PR had been queued. PR #23780 merged at 11:20Z as `6f7ad7900f`, so this card fixes forward. ⛔ Not a claim; lane and grade are triage's.

## 1. The missing changeset

- PR #23780 changed the anchor docblock in `packages/spec/src/identity/position.zod.ts` (packages suggest `everyone` only; no door binds `guest` until ADR-0138 D3 item 5's door is built). It carried `skip-changeset`, applied by this seat on a no-publish reading.
- That reading was wrong. `@objectstack/spec`'s `package.json` `files[]` includes `src/**/*.zod.ts`, and the review found the JSDoc on `EVERYONE_POSITION` / `GUEST_POSITION` in `dist/*.d.ts`. So the text ships, and AGENTS.md's changeset rule asks for a `'@objectstack/spec': patch` entry.
- The review read `@objectstack/lint`'s no-publish reading (`validate-security-posture.ts` comments) as right.
- **Remedy:** one `.changeset` file, `'@objectstack/spec': patch`, describing the docblock change. A changeset added before the next release is collected by the Version Packages PR as if it had ridden PR #23780.

## 2. The docs sentence

`content/docs/permissions/authorization.mdx:69-70` on `origin/main`:

> The `everyone`/`guest` audience-anchor bindings reject high-privilege sets at the data layer for every caller.

- The review reads it as untrue. The data-layer gate on anchor bindings retired with `sys_position_permission_set` (#23403, closed).
- What holds today, at this seat's quick read: `describeAnchorForbiddenBits` runs on the suggestion read and confirm paths (`plugin-security/src/suggested-audience-bindings.ts:512`, `:865`) and in the author-time rule (`lint/src/validate-security-posture.ts:940`).
- **Remedy:** the dev measures every place that refuses a high-privilege set bound to an anchor, then rewrites the sentence to name those places. Docs only.
